contract.callback_policy: validate exact types before digest/equality; digest does not invoke caller row serialization methods
contract.input_type_policy: exact CutoverBundle, SnapshotManifest, ActionRefEvidence and tuple rows with exact built-in primitive fields; arbitrary mappings/subclasses rejected
contract.snapshot_boundary_policy: same explicit snapshot_boundary_id required; status comparison assumes both source projections represent that same cutover boundary; boundary identifier is unauthenticated caller data
contract.state_policy: only READY, CLAIMED, COMPLETED accepted; per-identity state must match exactly; UNKNOWN, missing, unsupported, or differing state rejects

old G5 action reservation rows lack command ID and state; normalized legacy state requires a separately validated command join
V21 allocation needs command/correlation join to recover shared identity fields
same caller-supplied boundary ID does not authenticate simultaneous or complete capture
no external authenticated account-wide writer epoch or old-writer fence
no real account migration, deployment, provider, or live evidence
revision_changes: Reject source state mismatches for each identity even when account/action/reference match.

Require exact dataclass/container and built-in primitive types before any source comparison or digest construction.
